entry_point.code:
ZSTD_deriveBlockSplitsHelper(splits, startIdx, midIdx, zc, origSeqStore);
// left-child recursion: can fill the 196-entry split budget before the ancestor writes its own split position

critical_operation.code:
splits->splitLocations[splits->idx] = (U32)midIdx;
// OOB write: splits->idx has already reached ZSTD_MAX_NB_BLOCK_SPLITS (196), so this writes past partitions[]

trace.code: static size_t ZSTD_deriveBlockSplits(ZSTD_CCtx* zc, U32 partitions[], U32 nbSeq)  // splits.splitLocations = partitions; splits.idx = 0;
if (endIdx - startIdx < MIN_SEQUENCES_BLOCK_SPLITTING || splits->idx >= ZSTD_MAX_NB_BLOCK_SPLITS) { return; }  // budget checked only on function ENTRY
ZSTD_deriveBlockSplitsHelper(splits, startIdx, midIdx, zc, origSeqStore);  // left recursion increments splits->idx up to 196
splits->splitLocations[splits->idx] = (U32)midIdx;  // writes partitions[196] and beyond — past the 196-entry array
splits.splitLocations[splits.idx] = nbSeq;  // terminator write also lands out of bounds
U32 partitions[ZSTD_MAX_NB_BLOCK_SPLITS];  // 196 entries; the adjacent entropyMetadata field is what gets overwritten

preconditions: The application compresses attacker-influenced data with the block-level external sequence producer API (ZSTD_registerSequenceProducer + ZSTD_compress2), with ZSTD_c_splitAfterSequences enabled and ZSTD_c_validateSequences == 1 (the offload / hardware-accelerated / custom sequence-generator path; the CLI and default compress() paths do not use it)

The sequence stream contains enough small (3-byte) matches over a ~128 KiB block that the recursive block splitter makes more than ZSTD_MAX_NB_BLOCK_SPLITS (196) dyadic splits — 38,400 valid 3-byte matches reproduce this deterministically
No special privilege is required: it is an out-of-bounds array write within the (heap-allocated) compression context — it overwrites the adjacent entropyMetadata field, not arbitrary heap

evidence.vulnerable_version: zstd <= 1.5.7 (latest release, 2025-02-18); the missing re-check and the undersized partitions[] array are present since the block splitter landed (v1.5.6, 2024-03)
evidence.fixed_version: unreleased on master (974238ca, 2026-11-10); NOT in any release tag (latest release v1.5.7 predates it by ~21 months)
evidence.observed_result: Compiling the REAL libzstd (facebook/zstd) from source with musl-gcc, with only a canary field added after partitions[] in ZSTD_blockSplitCtx: driving ZSTD_compress2() with a 38,400-sequence external sequence producer over a 128,000-byte all-zero source, the v1.5.7 binary clobbers canary[0..3] (values 0x7788/0x79e0/0x8340/0x9600 — the midIdx split positions and the nbSeq=38400 terminator) and prints ZSTDOVERRUN-CANARY-CLOBBERED (exit 1), while the 974238ca binary leaves the canary intact and prints ZSTDOVERRUN-CANARY-INTACT (exit 0). Marker: ZSTDOVERRUN-CANARY-CLOBBERED.

real_exploit.target: libzstd (facebook/zstd) v1.5.7 — the real lib/compress/zstd_compress.c ZSTD_deriveBlockSplitsHelper() recursive block splitter, compiled from upstream source at tag v1.5.7 with musl-gcc; the only change from upstream is an 8-word canary field placed immediately after partitions[] in ZSTD_blockSplitCtx for deterministic OOB-write detection (ASAN unavailable)
real_exploit.backend: the real zstd-vuln (v1.5.7) and zstd-fixed (974238ca) static binaries, each built from the real library + driver.c; the driver registers a crafted external sequence producer and drives ZSTD_compress2()
real_exploit.demonstrated: zstd-vuln (v1.5.7) writes four U32 values past partitions[196] into the canary (0x7788/0x79e0/0x8340/0x9600 = the midIdx split positions and the nbSeq=38400 terminator) and exits 1 with ZSTDOVERRUN-CANARY-CLOBBERED; zstd-fixed (974238ca) leaves the canary untouched and exits 0 with ZSTDOVERRUN-CANARY-INTACT. In the uninstrumented build the same four words overwrite the ZSTD_entropyCTablesMetadata_t entropyMetadata field that immediately follows partitions[], i.e. silent corruption of the compression context (CWE-787).

evidence.notes: No CVE/GHSA as of 2026-11-15; upstream fixed it in 974238ca (2026-11-10, 'Fix block splitter partition bounds') with no advisory. The trigger is the block-level external-sequence API (ZSTD_registerSequenceProducer), used by offload/hardware-accelerated/custom sequence producers (contrib/externalSequenceProducer); the CLI (--patch-from) and the default ZSTD_compress()/decompress paths do NOT use this API, and the internal match-finder path is not known to reach 196 splits. The block splitter itself is also auto-enabled at btopt+ strategy with windowLog>=17, but the >196-split exhaustion demonstrated here needs the external-sequence path. Honest impact: a bounded intra-struct array OOB write (4 U32s) that overwrites the adjacent ZSTD_entropyCTablesMetadata_t entropyMetadata field of the same heap-allocated ZSTD_CCtx — NOT a heap overflow past the allocation, NOT a demonstrated RCE/crash/info-leak; the round-trip still succeeds so the corruption is 'silent'. Rated LOW 3.3 (AV:L, requires compressing crafted data through the sequence-producer path, integrity-only).
